description: Defines the interface 'PureCryptoInterface' for cryptographic operations used in the snjs library, including key derivation, encryption, decryption, hashing, and key generation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the cryptographic interface asynchronously.

methods.name: pbkdf2
methods.description: Derives a cryptographic key from a password and salt using PBKDF2 via WebCrypto.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Generates a random cryptographic key in hex format.

methods.name: aes256CbcEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext using AES-CBC with WebCrypto, returning Base64 ciphertext.

methods.name: aes256CbcDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts Base64 ciphertext using AES-CBC, returning plaintext or null.

methods.name: hmac256
methods.description: Computes HMAC with SHA-256 on a message.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of a string.

methods.name: hmac1
methods.description: Computes HMAC with SHA-1 on a message.

methods.name: unsafeSha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string for legacy purposes.

methods.name: argon2
methods.description: Derives a key using argon2id with specified parameters.

methods.name: xchacha20Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext with XChaCha20-Poly1305.

methods.name: xchacha20Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext with XChaCha20-Poly1305.

methods.name: xchacha20StreamInitEncryptor
methods.description: Initializes a stream encryptor for XChaCha20.

methods.name: xchacha20StreamEncryptorPush
methods.description: Pushes data into the stream encryptor to produce encrypted output.

methods.name: xchacha20StreamInitDecryptor
methods.description: Initializes a stream decryptor for XChaCha20.

methods.name: xchacha20StreamDecryptorPush
methods.description: Pushes encrypted data into the decryptor to retrieve plaintext.

methods.name: sodiumCryptoBoxEasyEncrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a message using NaCl crypto_box.

methods.name: sodiumCryptoBoxEasyDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a message using NaCl crypto_box.

methods.name: sodiumCryptoBoxGenerateKeypair
methods.description: Generates a public/private keypair for NaCl crypto_box.

methods.name: base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into base64.

methods.name: base64URLEncode
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-safe base64.

methods.name: base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into plain text.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes or cleans up the cryptographic interface.

methods.name: generateUUID
methods.description: Generates a UUID string synchronously.

methods.name: timingSafeEqual
methods.description: Performs a constant-time comparison of two strings.

methods.name: generateOtpSecret
methods.description: Generates a secret for TOTP authentication.

methods.name: hotpToken
methods.description: Generates an HOTP code based on a secret and counter.

methods.name: totpToken
methods.description: Generates a TOTP code based on a secret, timestamp, and step.
